title: Measured graphify retrieval arm on zonoid code nav corpus evidence chunk 2
summary: INSTALL (Windows, what worked): `winget install -e --id astral-sh.uv` then `uv tool install graphifyy` — clean, uv bundles Python (Python was NOT preinstalled). Pulls 30 pkgs incl. tree-sitter grammars + networkx + numpy. Binaries land in C:\Users\Imyu\.local\bin (not auto on PATH; prepend it). AST extraction needs NO API key: `graphify extract <path> --no-cluster --out <dir>` writes graphify-out/graph.json. Indexed lib (1523 nodes/2882 edges) + routes (174/345) separately to AVOID the .graph thrash, then `graphify merge-graphs` into one 1814-node graph. Queried with `graphify query "<q>" --budget 2000 --graph <merged>`. Output is NODE/EDGE text lines; identifier tokens = the symbol/function names.
